Jwt._comment: Local-only key. Production reads Jwt__SigningKey from the environment; the API refuses to start without one, because a built-in default would be a signing key shared by every deployment of this code.

Otp._comment: Returns the code in the response so the sell flow and the e2e tests can run without an SMS provider. Guarded in code by IHostEnvironment.IsDevelopment(); setting it elsewhere has no effect.

Bookings._comment: Local-only key. Production reads Bookings__HandoverSecret from the environment; the API refuses to start without one, because a shared default would turn every stored handover hash back into a lookup table.

Otlp._comment: Set an Endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:4317) to export. Left empty, telemetry is collected in process and exported nowhere, so the API boots with no collector listening.
